title: Synthetic-Fraud-AI-Project
summary: A credit card fraud detection sub-project that trains a classifier on the Kaggle creditcard.csv dataset and generates additional fraud samples to correct class imbalance. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata (the current SDV 1.x single-table API) to synthesize fraud-only rows for oversampling.
